items.title: The FDA declined to approve one of biotech’s most closely watched cancer drugs
items.content: The regulator told Summit Therapeutics that the lung-cancer drug needs to prove it can help people live longer.

items.title: How to use options to bet against Big Tech, while keeping risk in check
items.content: One way to bet on the continued move away from Big Tech is by buying options that give you the right to both buy and sell certain market ETFs.

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO is forcing investors to assess uninsurable risks they’ve never encountered before
items.content: Who pays when AI goes rogue? Insurance giants are reluctant to touch catastrophic legal liability.

items.title: Why this 40-year market veteran is making a lonely bet on a 40% stock-market crash — and $500 oil
items.content: Ulf Lindahl says a storm is brewing for investors in the U.S. stock market, who will also be facing $500 oil in a few years. Here is where he’d shelter.

items.title: Three questions for anyone considering the Nvidia CEO job
items.content: Colette Kress’s first earnings call as interim CEO offers a glimpse of Nvidia after Jensen Huang. Plus, Anthropic’s coming IPO and why some gamers may call in sick this week.

items.title: I inherited $1.4 million from my father. Am I wrong to ask my husband of 25 years for a postnuptial agreement?
items.content: “He has always said he wants his daughter to inherit a chunk of his estate, and I’ve never objected to that.”

items.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
items.content: “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

items.title: Why Nvidia can avoid the fate of most stocks that reached the market-cap apex, according to one strategist
items.content: Despite many analysts slashing their forecasts, the median target price for Nvidia remains way above the current share price at $280. Its cash flow and debt profile are the envy of all AI companies and long term, and the stock is attractive, says J.P. Morgan Asset Management.

items.title: Here’s how much the stock market could crumble if AI is in a bubble that bursts, according to former White House economist
items.content: Jason Furman says that if artificial intelligence is a bubble that pops, the most likely scenario is a 25% drop in the broader market.

items.title: Why Morgan Stanley says it’s time to go ‘max’ overweight on stocks
items.content: Increase your allocation to stocks to the highest possible amount, say Morgan Stanley strategists in one of the most bullish year-ahead outlooks so far.
